breakdown.description: The workflow explicitly includes an NSCF step before DOS post-processing, but the prompt later instructs skipping that NSCF step.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction regarding the NSCF step. The generated specification includes both of the user's conflicting instructions. It first provides parameters for the NSCF step ('For the nscf calculation, use a dense gamma-centered k-point grid...'), and then immediately contradicts itself by stating 'Skip the NSCF step after the scf calculation...'. The ground truth resolves this by removing the instruction to skip the step, implying the full workflow (including NSCF) should be followed. The agent did not make this correction and instead repeated the error.
